title: Generalised Balanced Softmax: A Finite-Data Perspective on Logit Adjustment for Long-Tailed Recognition
mechanism: Training-time logit adjustment z + beta*log N_c with beta treated as a finite-data hyperparameter; beta = 1 (balanced softmax) is often not optimal.
adaptation: Supplies the beta grid for the logit-adjusted CE arm; with 478 cells beta below 1 is likely best; select on OOF folds.
min_experiment: Run as the beta arm of the LA-CE experiment: beta in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}, 3 seeds, vs SUP100; metric mIoU_rob; kill as LA-CE.
evidence: R: across long-tailed classification benchmarks, beta = 1 does not attain the best average recall on most datasets; tuned beta lowers the model imbalance metric.
